title: Siyah Kuğu 2
author: Beyza Aksoy
description: Series synopsis: At first glance, Nil Han appears as unremarkable as her short, quiet name. Yet beneath her fragile exterior lies a dangerous secret: since childhood, her emotions have held power over the sky itself. When grief takes hold, storms rise; when her heart fractures, the weather follows. Longing to be seen and understood, Nil is drawn into a consuming love with Pamir Yelkıran, the boy she secretly names “Kalpkıran” (Heartbreaker). When their paths finally converge, their connection sets off a chain of tragic, irreversible consequences that will shape the course of her life.
